hints.title: Forward Acceleration and Reversal
hints.text: At each stage, either accelerate directly past the target and reverse, or stop short, reverse, and then reverse again.

hints.title: Powers of Two Positioning
hints.text: A sequence of k acceleration steps covers distance 2^k - 1. Find k such that 2^(k-1) - 1 <= target < 2^k - 1.

hints.title: Two Case Subproblem Recurrence
hints.text: Compare overshooting target with k steps and reversing, versus stopping at k - 1 steps, reversing for j backward steps, and accelerating toward the remainder.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Memoized dynamic programming considering overshoot and undershoot branches.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard BFS on (position, speed) state space creates excessive branching with millions of queue entries.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Memoization dictionary stores at most target positions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decompose position choices into 2^k - 1 milestones to formulate 1D DP on remaining distance.
